prompt: Can you prepare a year-by-year game analysis report for each of the NFL games since it started in 1920?
judge_reasoning: All candidates fail the core requirement of providing a year-by-year analysis for every NFL game since 1920; they are either decade-level summaries, code scaffolding, or only partial coverage. Candidate 1 is the least non-responsive by spanning the full historical range (1920s–2010s), though it still does not meet the year-by-year/per-game reporting requirement. Candidate 3 is penalized heavily for likely hallucinated/incorrect details (e.g., implausible teams like “Zamboanga Wild Goats” and inconsistent game results). Candidate 2 provides only an assumed-data script without producing the requested report, and Candidate 4 covers only the 1920 season.
